title.zh: Google DeepMind and Singapore Government announce new AI tool to protect citizens against scams
title.en: Google DeepMind and Singapore Government announce new AI tool to protect citizens against scams

current_state.zh: Google DeepMind and GovTech Singapore announced an on-device AI scam-detection tool built on lightweight Gemma models that intercepts conversational scams in private chats without any cloud data egress.
